errors.evidence: The figure contains two pie charts (a main pie chart on the left and a smaller inset/sub-pie chart on the right), not a single chart with three slices.

errors.text_span: 最小的切片为绿色，标记为“的”字只显现，占比约为18.34%。

The figure is composed of two connected pie charts, with the right pie acting as a breakdown of the yellow slice from the left pie; it is not a three-slice pie chart.
The description does not mention that the figure consists of a main pie chart and a smaller inset pie chart connected by gray lines.
The description omits the color-to-category mapping shown in the figure: blue for 双音形容词+单音名词, yellow for 单音形容词+单音名词, orange for “的”字只隐不现, and green for “的”字只显不隐.

errors.text_span: 切片似乎按照从大到小的顺序排列，但并非严格遵守，因为橙色的切片大于黄色的切片。
errors.evidence: This is interpretive and misleading: the orange and green slices are from a separate inset pie, so comparing their size to the main pie's yellow slice as if they were part of one ordered set is not supported by the figure.
